timing_scope.primary: fresh solver construction plus capped counting
timing_scope.rust: FFI call including Layout construction, Solver construction, and count_up_to(2)
timing_scope.excluded: process startup, JSON, Python validation, thermo string/ctypes buffer construction
timing_scope.count_only_status: native diagnostic decomposition; not compared to a Rust count-only API

case_selection: Blue unique, all fourteen score-3 layouts, ten deterministic spread layouts
native_mode: persistent native .NET Release CLR/JIT process (the upstream-documented native mode, not NativeAOT); single-threaded solver; runtime-reported GC mode
merge_method: concatenate per-case phase samples from independent runs, then recompute medians and aggregate ratios from the merged samples
